description: Analyze codebase for issues, patterns, and improvement opportunities

task_steps.title: Identify Analysis Scope
task_steps.description: Determine which files or directories to analyze based on user input or recent changes
guidance: If no specific target provided, focus on recently modified files
Check for files with high complexity or known problem areas

task_steps.title: Run Code Analysis
task_steps.description: Execute static analysis tools to identify potential issues
guidance: Look for security vulnerabilities, code smells, and anti-patterns
Check for duplicate code and overly complex functions

task_steps.title: Prioritize Findings
task_steps.description: Rank issues by severity and impact
guidance: Consider blast radius - how much code is affected
Factor in fix complexity vs impact

task_steps.title: Report Analysis Results
guidance: Provide clear fix suggestions for each issue
